trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Two of you? Then we'll take your Pokémon as well!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Nobody said there'd be Trainers down here...

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: You're in Team Galactic's way. Big mistake!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: I want to go back to headquarters.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Damon: These tunnels were dug by hand, you know. I come down here to feel the rock all round me.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Damon: I thought we were as tough as this island's iron. Not tough enough, it seems.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Maurice: Heave-ho! My Pokémon are every bit as tough as the rock we're standing in!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Maurice: Crumbled like old shale. You've got real grit, you have.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Kendal: I train in the deepest tunnels, where nobody can hear me shout. Hyaah!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Kendal: Even down here, there's someone stronger. Back to my training.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Battle Girl Tyler: Breathe in... breathe out... Medicham and I are ready. Are you?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Battle Girl Tyler: My focus slipped. A real fighter stays calm, win or lose.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Brendon: The mine's closed, but my crew still come down to look at the old seams. And to battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Brendon: You hit like a pickaxe. My Pokémon need a tea break.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Quentin: Mind your head down here! And mind your Pokémon, because here we come!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Quentin: Knocked flat. Good thing I kept my helmet on.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Jonah: They say this island teems with Steel-type Pokémon. I came to test my team against them, and against you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Jonah: I've a long way to go yet. That's what makes the trip worth it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Brenda: Nobody comes this deep by accident. Let's see what you're made of!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Brenda: So that's how it's done. I'll remember that.
